text.index.ts: Mounts the problems list in a Lantern panel's bottom bar: a button counting errors, warnings and notices by severity, a popover list above it, keyboard-navigable and sorted by severity with file and line locations (double-click or Enter opens the file), per-row action buttons (with an optional hover tip and pressed state), and short-lived toasts for items flagged to pop up
text.index.ts gotcha: Toasts show once per item id and stay hidden while the list is open; hovering a toast pauses its countdown
